name: @aliran/i18n
description: Aliran viewer i18n — zero-dependency translation runtime, React hook and locale catalogs shared by the mobile/TV and desktop apps
comment: Ships TypeScript source with NO build step — both viewer apps consume it directly (Metro reads it through client/metro.config.js watchFolders, esbuild bundles TS+JSON natively for the desktop renderer), the same arrangement as sdk/react-native. Operator surfaces (panel/ broadcaster/ reseller/ library/) must NOT depend on this package: they are plain no-build dashboards with no bundler to read TypeScript. The reseller dashboard is translated, and carries its OWN self-contained catalog in reseller/control-ui/i18n.js for exactly that reason; tools/i18n-test.mjs guards both.
